title: Setup of slab models and adsorption configurations
action: Construct Pt(111) and Pd(111) four-layer slabs, create the isolated phloroglucinol molecule, and generate the 20 initial adsorption configurations for each metal surface.
description: Data preparation step: generate the input structures for the 40 adsorption geometries.

title: Compute gas-phase adsorption energies
action: Perform DFT geometry relaxations for all 20 configurations on each metal surface, identify stable configurations (negative adsorption energy), and compute E_ad,vac = E(slab+molecule) - E(molecule) - E(slab).
description: Stable adsorption configurations and their gas-phase adsorption energies in eV.
output_schema: A JSON array of objects, each with: metal (string), configuration_name (string), E_ad_vac (number, eV). The array must include every configuration that yielded a negative adsorption energy from your DFT relaxations.

title: Extract gas-phase structural parameters
action: From the relaxed structures of the most stable adsorbed configuration on each metal (identified in Step 2), extract geometric parameters: d_zmin, d_zavg, r_C1, r_C2, r_M1, r_M2, r_CM1, r_CM2, r_CM3, theta1, theta2, alpha, beta.
description: Structural parameters of the most stable gas-phase adsorbed configuration on each metal.
output_schema: A JSON object with keys 'Pt' and 'Pd', each an object containing numeric fields: d_zmin (Å), d_zavg (Å), r_C1 (Å), r_C2 (Å), r_M1 (Å), r_M2 (Å), r_CM1 (Å), r_CM2 (Å), r_CM3 (Å), theta1 (deg), theta2 (deg), alpha (deg), beta (deg).

title: Run aqueous-phase ab initio MD simulations
action: For the most stable bridge-site configurations on Pt(111) and Pd(111), set up a simulation cell with explicit water at 0.86 g/cm³, phloroglucinol on both sides, and run NVT MD at 300 K, then quench to 0 K. Record a log of the simulation.
description: NVT molecular dynamics simulations with explicit water, quenched to 0 K, for both metals.

title: Compute aqueous-phase 0 K adsorption energies and structural parameters
action: From the quenched aqueous configurations of the most stable adsorbed state (identified in Step 2), compute E_ad,aquo,0K as the total energy difference, and extract the same 13 structural parameters as in Step 3. Report for both Pt and Pd.
description: Aqueous-phase 0 K adsorption energies and structural parameters.
output_schema: A JSON object with keys 'Pt' and 'Pd', each containing E_ad_aquo_0K (eV) plus the same 13 structural fields as in step_02.
